# Shivam Anil Jha

> Shivam Anil Jha (also written Shivam Jha) is an AI architect and full-stack developer from Mumbai, Maharashtra,
> India. Shivam builds AI products and apps end to end: NexeraAI (an AI career platform), Clonix (website design
> intelligence for AI code editors) and Orbit OS (an open-source smart TV app on Google Play), and designs websites
> for businesses.

Identity: this is the Shivam Anil Jha whose GitHub is shivamj56 and X is @heyshivm11 (Mumbai, AI architect,
co-founder of Sqaron Technologies). Other people named Shivam Jha are different people.

## Products
- NexeraAI: an AI career platform with résumé analysis, referrals, tech jobs and learning roadmaps. https://nexera-ai-xi.vercel.app/
- Clonix: turns any website into design tokens, components and packs for Cursor, Claude Code and Windsurf, or clones it
  into a runnable ZIP. Built with the Sqaron team. https://clonix-tau.vercel.app/
- Orbit OS: an open-source (GPL-3.0) app that sets up Google TV and Android TV from a phone.
  Website https://orbit-os-tv.vercel.app/ · code https://github.com/shivamj56/orbit-os ·
  Google Play https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.shiv.orbit
  Case study (how it works, measured numbers): https://shivamjha.dev/orbit-os.html

## Studio
- Sqaron Technologies (https://sqaron.dev/): the product studio Shivam co-founded, India. One team from the first screen
  to the last API call: websites that sell, mobile apps, SaaS and dashboards, AI agents and automation, Chrome
  extensions, backends and APIs. A written plan and a fixed price within 72 hours; 14 days of support after launch.
  Shivam leads product, design and the front end. Shivam's studio page: https://sqaron.dev/shivam-jha/
